topics.title: llama.cpp adds pplx-decider (Perplexity's open 27B decision model)
topics.why: Apache-2.0 Qwen3.8-27B finetune now converts to GGUF and serves through llama-server's systemone decision endpoint, same path as OpenJev. Perplexity's card claims v1.1 tops Jev on the Decision Index; no official GGUF yet.

topics.title: llama.cpp mainline support for K2 Horizon dense + MoVA
topics.why: IFM's K2 Horizon family (incl. MoVA-36B-A4B) now loads in stock llama.cpp with a dedicated reasoning/tool-call parser.

topics.title: llama.cpp RPC gets tensor-parallel split (-sm tensor)
topics.why: Split one model tensor-parallel across networked machines over RPC; PR demo ran a 284B MXFP4 MoE on two DGX Sparks.

topics.title: Google EmbeddingGemma 2 (740M, Apache 2.0)
topics.why: On-device multimodal embeddings (text, code, image, audio, video) with same-day GGUF and MLX builds.
